function textAdjustCase(v) {
  document.body.innerHTML='';document.body.style.cssText='margin:0';
  const parent=document.createElement('main');parent.style.cssText='font-size:20px;text-size-adjust:auto';document.body.append(parent);
  const sheet=document.createElement('style');document.head.append(sheet);
  const e=document.createElement('div');e.id='target';e.style.cssText='width:40px;height:10px';parent.append(e);
  const s=getComputedStyle(e),checks={};
  const check=(name,css,expected,rules='')=>{sheet.textContent=rules;e.style.cssText='width:40px;height:10px;'+css;checks[name]=s.textSizeAdjust===expected&&s.webkitTextSizeAdjust===expected&&s.getPropertyValue('-webkit-text-size-adjust')===expected&&s.fontSize==='20px'&&e.getBoundingClientRect().width===40;};
  check('default','','auto');check('none','text-size-adjust:none','100%');check('auto','text-size-adjust:auto','auto');
  check('percentage',`text-size-adjust:${50+v}%`,`${50+v}%`);
  check('webkit',`-webkit-text-size-adjust:${100+v}%`,`${100+v}%`);
  check('zero','text-size-adjust:0%','0%');
  check('calc','text-size-adjust:calc(10% + 20%)','30%');
  check('negativeCalc','text-size-adjust:calc(0% - 10%)','0%');
  check('min','text-size-adjust:min(10%, 20%)','10%');
  check('max','text-size-adjust:max(10%, 20%)','20%');
  check('clamp','text-size-adjust:clamp(10%, 30%, 20%)','20%');
  check('standardLast','-webkit-text-size-adjust:120%;text-size-adjust:80%','80%');
  check('webkitLast','text-size-adjust:80%;-webkit-text-size-adjust:120%','120%');
  check('standardImportant','text-size-adjust:80%!important;-webkit-text-size-adjust:120%','80%');
  check('webkitImportant','-webkit-text-size-adjust:120%!important;text-size-adjust:80%','120%');
  check('specificity','','80%','div{-webkit-text-size-adjust:120%}#target{text-size-adjust:80%}');
  check('sourceOrder','','80%','#target{-webkit-text-size-adjust:120%}#target{text-size-adjust:80%}');
  check('inlineOrigin','-webkit-text-size-adjust:120%','120%','#target{text-size-adjust:80%}');
  check('sheetImportant','-webkit-text-size-adjust:120%','80%','#target{text-size-adjust:80%!important}');
  check('layers','','80%','@layer early,late;@layer early{#target{-webkit-text-size-adjust:120%}}@layer late{div{text-size-adjust:80%}}');
  check('importantLayers','','120%','@layer early,late;@layer early{div{-webkit-text-size-adjust:120%!important}}@layer late{#target{text-size-adjust:80%!important}}');
  check('variable',`--adjust:${70+v}%;-webkit-text-size-adjust:var(--adjust)`,`${70+v}%`);
  check('invalidVariable','text-size-adjust:var(--missing)','auto');
  sheet.textContent='';parent.style.textSizeAdjust='125%';
  check('inherit','text-size-adjust:inherit','125%');check('unset','text-size-adjust:unset','125%');
  check('implicitInheritance','','125%');check('initial','text-size-adjust:initial','auto');
  e.style.cssText='-webkit-text-size-adjust:120%;text-size-adjust:80%';
  checks.inlineAlias=e.style.webkitTextSizeAdjust==='80%'&&e.style.textSizeAdjust==='80%';
  checks.canonicalCss=e.style.cssText==='text-size-adjust: 80%;';
  checks.canonicalIndex=e.style.length===1&&e.style.item(0)==='text-size-adjust';
  e.style.webkitTextSizeAdjust='150%';checks.aliasMutation=e.style.textSizeAdjust==='150%'&&s.textSizeAdjust==='150%';
  e.style.textSizeAdjust='-1%';checks.invalidNegative=s.textSizeAdjust==='150%'&&e.style.textSizeAdjust==='150%';
  e.style.textSizeAdjust='garbage';checks.invalidKeyword=s.textSizeAdjust==='150%';
  e.style.setProperty('-WEBKIT-TEXT-SIZE-ADJUST','90%','important');checks.setAlias=e.style.getPropertyValue('text-size-adjust')==='90%'&&e.style.getPropertyPriority('-webkit-text-size-adjust')==='important'&&s.textSizeAdjust==='90%';
  checks.removeAlias=e.style.removeProperty('-webkit-text-size-adjust')==='90%'&&e.style.textSizeAdjust===''&&s.textSizeAdjust==='125%';
  parent.style.textSizeAdjust='175%';checks.liveInheritance=s.textSizeAdjust==='175%';
  sheet.textContent='#target{-webkit-text-size-adjust:60%}';checks.liveSheet=s.textSizeAdjust==='60%';
  sheet.textContent='#target{text-size-adjust:70%}';checks.liveSheetAlias=s.textSizeAdjust==='70%';
  const throws=(fn,name)=>{try{fn();return false;}catch(e){return e.name===name;}};
  checks.readOnlyAlias=throws(()=>{s.webkitTextSizeAdjust='10%'},'NoModificationAllowedError');
  checks.priorityComputed=s.getPropertyPriority('-webkit-text-size-adjust')==='';
  checks.uppercaseComputed=s.getPropertyValue('-WEBKIT-TEXT-SIZE-ADJUST')==='70%';
  const external=document.createElement('div');external.id='external';parent.append(external);
  checks.external=getComputedStyle(external).textSizeAdjust===`${50+v}%`;
  e.remove();checks.detached=s.textSizeAdjust==='';parent.append(e);checks.reattached=s.textSizeAdjust==='70%';
  sheet.remove();return checks;
}
